verdict.rationale: Gram documents a built-in catalog for discovering and importing official third-party MCP servers, sourced from the official MCP Registry, and lists third-party catalog servers among a project's tool sources. The evidence never states how many integrations the catalog holds, so the 'hundreds to thousands' depth is unproven. The MoonPay figure of 200+ servers describes one customer's own servers brought under the gateway, not catalog size, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented catalog size or breadth (hundreds to thousands of apps/APIs), a list of available integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: Discover and import official third-party MCP servers, powered by the official MCP Registry.
Every tool source in the project in one place: OpenAPI documents, TypeScript functions, third-party catalog servers, custom remote MCP servers, and tunneled MCP servers.
